svg.text: Three ways to answer one question: is this point inside?
All three are implemented (sign_oracle.cpp). docs/ARCHITECTURE.md claims PSEUDONORMAL is a no-op — it is wrong.
O(3k log T) the DEFAULT, and the most expensive
the three rays share an origin, so a
O(log T) one traversal + an O(1) lookup — the cheapest
Find the closest surface point, then
test dot(p - cp, n) < 0 against the
boundary edges degrade to the face
O(log T) a multipole walk; needs the tree built
Sum the solid angle each triangle
the only one that works on open shells
i.e. 'all outside', if the tree was
The epsilon that breaks the vote
countRayHits advances past each hit by max(tHit * 1e-5, 1e-6) — relative to the HIT DISTANCE, not the model's feature size. At tHit = 2000 mm that is
0.02 mm, so a thin wall, a lattice strut or a duplicated coincident triangle within 0.02 mm is skipped, the parity flips, and all three rays fail together.
